title: Grateful Dead Live at Seattle Center Arena on 1973-06-26

ai_review.summary: Warm matrix recording of a high‑energy June 26 1973 Seattle show with solid song selection and clear, enjoyable sound
ai_review.review: Fans praise this MTX (matrix) tape for its warm, pleasant listening experience and recommend using EQ or headphones to get the most out of the blend. The concert is described as energetic with a strong set‑list spanning over three hours, though no specific songs are singled out. Recording quality is generally good with a pleasing audience/soundboard mix.

ai_rating.rationale: Most detailed reviews highlight an enjoyable performance and a solid matrix recording; only a few off‑topic negative posts exist, so the overall impression is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Blend of audience and soundboard unknown percentage; listeners note it sounds warm and benefits from loud playback or headphones and EQ adjustments. No major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑plus hour set with over 30 songs, praised for good song selection and sustained energy throughout.
